Important Registration & Refund Policy

Cancellation & Refund

Written request to keralaaroi@gmail.com on or before 25 December 2026 qualifies for a 50% refund (paid by bank transfer within 1 month after the conference ends). Include full name, registration ID or transaction reference, reason, and bank details (beneficiary name, account number, bank, branch, IFSC code). No refund after 25 December 2026.
